visual_checks.diagram_nodes_and_labels: All 48 diagrams in 12 paired sheets inspected at 120 dpi. Official marks, category chips, node titles and descriptions are visible and contained; no clipped text or missing glyphs seen.
visual_checks.arrows_and_legend: Orthogonal paths, numbered arrows and localized legends remain distinct from node content. No route or label is cut by the rounded outer boundary.
visual_checks.variety: 24 context-specific compositions retained across Portuguese and English, with role-specific official technology marks and non-brand symbols for people or abstract entities.
visual_checks.rounded_images: Photographs and source images show subtle rounded corners. Diagram outer bounds retain all visible content. Official logo silhouettes are unchanged.
visual_checks.page_layout: Sampled covers, contents, profile, evidence and credits retain separated body, sources and footer navigation. Full-page architecture samples preserve caption and prose spacing.
visual_checks.typography: PDF-rendered labels and node titles were inspected at 120 dpi; smaller technology names and secondary route labels remain legible when enlarged. Vector diagram text scales with PDF zoom.
visual_checks.navigation: Visible localized footer controls on every sampled page, including covers and credits; full native-link validation independently passed all 640 pages.
visual_checks.technology_provenance: diagram-technology-map.json lists proposed technology placement and official-source references. Marks identify proposed implementations and do not establish internal Nubank architecture.

limitations: Visual review focuses on the 48 redesigned diagrams and 12 non-diagram samples; the complete 640-page navigation and clip validation is automated.
Source screenshots retain their original resolution and language; no screenshot content was regenerated or enhanced.
